event.title: Userlens was accepted into Y Combinator
event.summary: Demo Day is in a few weeks at @ycombinator Quick recap of what happened since we joined YC: - came in from Helsinki with $35k ARR - grew @userlens_hq to $250k ARR ($300k+ by Demo Day) - held over 20% WoW growth through the batch - raised prices and still kept closing customers.
